findings.detail: 11 distinct Extended parts, about $33 in JLC loading fees
findings.fix: swap an Extended part for a Basic one where the table lists one

parts.table_source: HeyPCB runner/cache/jlcparts/cache.sqlite3, table jlc_components, queried 2026-09-26. Each row's `snapshot` is that row's fetched_at.

log: J1 -> (15.00, 5.05) rot 0 : rung 0 lock: bus socket IN at the top: pins in a row along x with pin 2 on the vertical axis, courtyard from y -16.1 to -10.1 mm about the centre (the spec's position)
J2 -> (20.00, 29.95) rot 180 : rung 0 lock: bus socket OUT opposite J1, turned 180 degrees so the two sockets are point-symmetric about the motor axis

U1 -> (17.50, 17.50) rot 90 : rung 0 lock: MCU on the axis, top face, turned 90 degrees: its ADC pins (PA4-PA7) and the bridge enable (PB0) face the DRV8311, its TIM1 pins (PA8-PA10) face up toward the driver's INH pins, SPI1 faces the encoder's SSI pins underneath
U3 -> (17.50, 17.50) rot 90 : rung 0 lock: MT6701QT exactly on the motor axis on the motor-facing face; turned so its SSI pins (DO, CLK, CSN) sit under the MCU's SPI1 edge
C13 -> (20.70, 17.50) rot 270 : rung 0 lock: the encoder's 100 nF at r = 3.2 mm across its VDD and GND pins, inside the magnet pocket where the spec allows it (r >= 3.0)

U2 -> (27.00, 18.00) rot 90 : rung 0 lock: driver 9.5 mm right of the axis (the spec keeps it and the phase copper at r >= 6 mm), its OUTC/B/A edge facing the motor holes; the areas above it (PWM in) and below it (current sense out) are kept free of parts for routing
J4 -> (31.30, 19.00) rot 90 : rung 0 lock: the three phase holes at the right rim, C at the top and A at the bottom in the order of the driver's OUTC/B/A pins, so the phases fan out without crossing

J3 -> (3.70, 17.50) rot 90 : rung 0 lock: Tag-Connect pads on the motor-facing face at the left rim: zero height; flash before the motor goes on. Its three alignment holes are kept clear of top-side pads
C1 -> (15.60, 21.50) rot 0 : rung 0 lock: VDD (pin 1) decoupling below the MCU
C2 -> (21.72, 15.42) rot 0 : rung 0 lock: VDD (pin 17) decoupling at the MCU's top-right corner, below the PWM lane
C3 -> (21.72, 16.52) rot 0 : rung 0 lock: VDDA 100 nF at the MCU's VDDA / VSSA pins
C4 -> (23.72, 15.42) rot 0 : rung 0 lock: VDDA 1 uF beside the VDD cap
C5 -> (8.45, 20.85) rot 0 : rung 0 lock: NRST filter on the bottom face beside the bus passives, out of the MCU's bottom-edge fan-out
R1 -> (13.60, 18.90) rot 90 : rung 0 lock: BOOT0 pull-down beside the MCU's PB8
R2 -> (23.60, 17.60) rot 90 : rung 0 lock: bridge-enable pull-down, bottom face beside the driver's INLC pin
C6 -> (29.50, 21.75) rot 0 : rung 0 lock: VM 100 nF below the phase lane
C7 -> (31.35, 22.15) rot 90 : rung 0 lock: VM 10 uF below the phase lane
C8 -> (27.90, 22.30) rot 90 : rung 0 lock: VIN_AVDD 100 nF below the phase lane
C9 -> (29.65, 23.90) rot 90 : rung 0 lock: VIN_AVDD 10 uF

C11 -> (26.80, 15.00) rot 90 : rung 0 lock: AVDD output capacitor above the driver's AVDD / AGND pins, left of the INH pins
